title: The hanging plate
summary: Hero A's bar (tracked caps, no dots, an outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗) drops a flat FIG. plate from its hairline. Across three capability strips the Kelwin mark assembles one solid piece at a time (K1 Narrative, K2 Infrastructure, K3 Intelligence), so the menu itself argues 'three layers, one system'. The selected piece is the plate's one red element, and the red System Audit door sits flush in the plate's corner cell. A numbered figure replaces today's floating glass cards and line icons.

reference.borrowed: A full-width sheet drops from the header and is split into equal columns by full-height 1px verticals. The hovered link becomes a filled bar, and an info band along the sheet's bottom edge repeats and explains whatever is under the cursor.
reference.kelwin: Pinterest's five columns become three capability strips on cols 1–4 / 5–8 / 9–12 of a flat --panel plate hung margin to margin from hero A's hairline. Each strip opens on the corrected three-piece mark (152-unit master), set on one figure row whose hairline runs under all three strips and built cumulatively: strip 1 shows K1, strip 2 adds K2 over a ghost K1, and strip 3 completes the mark with K3. The plate is an unnumbered INDEX (the nav is global, so it never takes a FIG. number; the page's figures start at the hero's FIG. 01 film). Under the hairline each strip carries its mono CAP. 0n index, a 28px wide title, the descriptor and a 4-row manifest. The hover bar becomes a --panel-2 manifest row. The info band becomes A's 64px caption band, cut into the same three cells: a mono caption that narrates the selection ('INDEX · 02 / 03 · INFRASTRUCTURE'), a note explaining the System Audit, and a flat red REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗ cell flush in the plate's corner. The bar repeats hero A metric for metric: 96px, a 24px lockup, 12px Mona 500 caps at .18em, a 44px outlined action, and the open item marking the hairline.

motion: entrance: the bar hairline draws left to right (900ms) and the open item's 1px marker draws on it. The plate unrolls downward from the hairline (clip-path, 700ms --ease-out), the strip verticals draw top-down through the band, strip titles rise out of masks (800ms, 120ms stagger), and descriptors and manifest rows fade up 12px (70ms row stagger).

entrance (the orchestrated moment): the index plate's mark assembles left to right. The ghost pieces fade in, then each strip's own piece slides in from the top-right (K1 at 1.0s, K2 at 1.24s, K3 at 1.48s; 700ms each). The plate starts with nothing selected and the caption reads 'INDEX · THREE CAPABILITIES, ONE SYSTEM'.

state change (demo at ~2.4s): the pointer settles on CAP. 02. K2 turns red, the title and CAP. label lift to --fg, row 02 takes the --panel-2 bar and the caption crossfades to 'INDEX · 02 / 03 · INFRASTRUCTURE' (900ms --ease-inout). This is the 'installed' beat.

interaction: hovering or focusing any strip selects it, and the red piece, title, row bar and caption follow. Rows fill --panel-2 on hover, title arrows nudge 3px, the red cell darkens to --accent-hover and its ↗ moves 2px up-right, and the outlined nav action's border goes to --fg.

ambient: only the hero film (hero A's calibration: blur 8px, frost .20, 32s drift). Two men seen from behind frame a seated colleague in the strip of film left open under the plate, and the whole room shows through during the entrance.
on the live site: the plate opens on hover or focus of CAPABILITIES (aria-expanded) and closes on Esc or pointer-leave. Reduced motion shows the final state (CAP. 02 selected).
notes: Stage is 800px (not 760) so the film strip under the plate is tall enough for heads and shoulders to read. The film plate uses hero A's scale and crop lowered by ~140px for that reason. The mark is drawn from brand/kelwin-mark.svg geometry (viewBox 152) at 88px. Unselected pieces are --line-2 and ghosts --panel-2, so the single red piece leads. Arrows are drawn SVG, because the brand fonts carry no arrow glyphs. Coherence pass: the caption no longer claims FIG. 00 — the nav is global, so its plate is an unnumbered INDEX ('INDEX · 02 / 03 · INFRASTRUCTURE') and the page's figures start at the hero's FIG. 01; the K-jargon left the CAP. labels; the film shares the hero's calibration (blur 8px, frost .20). The bar is hero A's bar metric for metric (lockup, 12px tracked-caps items with no separators, outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗, hairline), and the interior page uses the same bar.
